title: Invention of the Mondaloy superalloy
place_text: Rockwell Science Center; Air Force Research Laboratory, Wright-Patterson AFB

tellings.quote: The stalemate finally shattered in the 1990s thanks to the hard work of Dallas Hardwick and Monica Resza at the Rockwell Science Center.

plain: Michels says a long stalemate in metals research was broken in the 1990s, when Dallas Hardwick and Monica Reza at the Rockwell Science Center created Mondaloy, a high-performance superalloy. He tells this himself, drawing on a National Academies report, the Mondaloy patents and reporting in SpaceNews, in an episode about American scientists who have gone missing.
